valid_disclosure_types.description: k-anonymity threshold: minimum equivalence-class size for a released disclosure. Higher k = tighter protection.
l-diversity threshold: minimum distinct sensitive-attribute values per equivalence class. Higher l = tighter protection.
Differential-privacy epsilon budget. Lower epsilon = tighter protection (less privacy leak per query).
